topStories.headline: US and Iran Pause Military Strikes; Brent Crude Tumbles More Than 5%
topStories.summary: The US refrained from striking Iran for a second consecutive night and Tehran suspended its retaliatory strikes, easing fears of a prolonged Middle East conflict and Strait of Hormuz supply disruption.
topStories.marketImpact: Brent ↓ ~5% to ~$91/bbl; WTI ↓ ~5.5% to ~$84/bbl; Nasdaq 100 futures ↑ >1%; energy stocks ↓ (XOM, CVX, XLE); AUD and EUR ↑ vs USD on risk-on tone

topStories.headline: FOMC Meets Tuesday–Wednesday; Market Expects Hold at 3.50–3.75%
topStories.summary: The Fed's July 28-29 meeting is the week's biggest macro event; markets are pricing near-certainty of no change with inflation still above target and no new dot plot to be released.
topStories.marketImpact: Rate-sensitive sectors watch; US 10Y at 4.69% — any dovish hint could send yields ↓ and lift TLT, XLU, XLF; hawkish surprise would reprice equities ↓

topStories.headline: Big Tech Earnings on Trial Over AI Spending: Meta and Microsoft Report Wednesday
topStories.summary: Meta guided Q2 revenue at $58–61B and raised its 2026 capex to $125–145B; Microsoft targets ~$190B capex; investor patience with AI spend is fraying as Meta trades 24% below its 52-week high.
topStories.marketImpact: META ↓ risk on guidance; MSFT watch on Azure AI growth; AAPL reports Thursday; NVDA and AVGO directional on Big Tech capex commentary

topStories.headline: S&P 500 Q2 Earnings Off to a 5-Year-Best Start; 86% of Reporters Beat EPS
topStories.summary: With 27% of S&P 500 companies reporting, 86% beat EPS and 80% beat revenue targets, putting Q2 2026 on track for the highest year-over-year earnings growth rate since Q3 2021.
topStories.marketImpact: SPY ↑ broadly supportive; breadth risk — ex-GOOGL the aggregate surprise rate falls from 39.3% to 12.6%, highlighting concentration in Alphabet's outsized beat

topStories.headline: Zhongji Innolight Eyes HK$63.3B IPO — Potential Largest Hong Kong Listing of 2026
topStories.summary: The world's top optical module maker — whose Q1 2026 revenue surged 192% YoY — aims to raise up to HK$63.3B ($8.1B including greenshoe) backed by 33 cornerstone investors including Temasek, ADIA, BlackRock, Alibaba, and Tencent.
topStories.marketImpact: HK IPO market sentiment ↑; Alibaba (9988.HK) and Tencent (0700.HK) as anchor investors watch; AI optical interconnect sector positive

topStories.headline: Moonshot AI Releases Kimi K3 Open Weights — World's Largest Open-Source Model at 2.8T Parameters
topStories.summary: China's Moonshot AI dropped the full 2.8-trillion-parameter Kimi K3 weights on Hugging Face today — the largest open-weight release in history — rivaling top US frontier systems in coding and reasoning.
topStories.marketImpact: Chinese AI competitiveness ↑ (Alibaba 9988.HK, Baidu 9888.HK, SenseTime 0020.HK watch); pressure on premium attached to closed US frontier models; open-source AI infrastructure demand ↑

topStories.headline: Nikkei Searches for Floor at 64,611 as Yen Hits 39-Year Low Near ¥164/USD
topStories.summary: Japan's Nikkei 225 fell 2.73% to 64,611 on Friday, down sharply from a June peak above 72,000, as AI spending jitters hammered tech stocks and the yen weakened to its lowest level since the late 1980s.
topStories.marketImpact: Japanese exporters (7203.T, 6758.T) ↑ on yen weakness; AI chip equipment (6857.T, 8035.T) ↓ on capex concerns; week defined by FOMC and BOJ outcomes

topStories.headline: Bank of Japan Set to Hold Rates at 1% at July 30–31 Meeting
topStories.summary: The BOJ is widely expected to hold its benchmark rate at 1% following June's 25bp hike to a 31-year high, though GDP growth forecasts for FY2026 may be revised up to ~0.8% on AI-driven export demand.
topStories.marketImpact: JPY near ¥164/USD; any hawkish surprise → yen ↑ sharply and Nikkei exporters ↓; JGBs watch; SoftBank (9984.T) sensitive to rate path as leveraged tech investor
